_why: The quote find (CONTRACT §2 page + quote, quote-only references) adopts the stock parts the prior-art note recommends (Linked Sources — Off-the-Shelf Citation Viewers, 2026-11-05) instead of a home-grown fuzzy matcher. They are pinned copies loaded on demand by source-highlighter.js, so the module still needs no build step and no network. tests/test_vendor.py re-hashes every file against this record. To update one: copy the new file, then change its version, origin and sha256 here together.

match-quote.js.changes: TypeScript types stripped; imports ./approx-string-match.js; matchQuote's ranking split out as matchQuoteAll, which returns every scored candidate with its errors (matchQuote still returns the top one). source-highlighter.js wraps matchQuoteAll so two or more places are reported as ambiguous, never picked from.
